name: Kestrel 240 Racing Quadcopter
description: A 5-inch racing quadcopter modelled as a product: NACA-section fuselage shells and swept arm fairings over carbon spars, four motor modules with stators, bells, bearings and handed propellers, a flight-controller and power stack, and a two-axis camera gimbal. 43 part types are placed as 123 named parts. Pitch and yaw drive the gimbal, and GeoSpec checks the whole vehicle for collisions across its travel.
